paragraphs: The following describes the business of Cannae Holdings, Inc. and its subsidiaries. Except where otherwise noted, all references to "we," "us," "our," "Cannae," "Cannae Holdings" or the "Company," are to Cannae Holdings, Inc. and its subsidiaries, taken together.

We primarily acquire interests in operating companies and are engaged in actively managing and operating a core group of those companies, which we are committed to supporting for the long term. From time to time, we also seek to take meaningful equity ownership stakes where we have the ability to control or significantly influence quality companies, and we bring the strength of our operational expertise to each of our subsidiaries. We are a long-term owner that secures control and governance rights of other companies primarily to engage in their lines of business, and we have no preset time constraints dictating when we sell or dispose of our businesses. We believe that our long-term ownership and active involvement in the management and operations of companies helps maximize the value of those businesses for our shareholders.

We believe Cannae provides our investors with a compelling opportunity to participate in the acquisition, operation and growth of businesses by a world-class management team. Fundamentally, the Company seeks to take meaningful equity ownership stakes where we have an ability to control or significantly influence quality companies that are well-positioned in their respective industries, run by best-in-class management teams and that operate in industries that have attractive organic and acquired growth opportunities. We leverage our management team's operational expertise, long-term relationships and industry connections and capital sourcing capabilities to identify, structure and execute on ownership interests in companies with these characteristics.

Our management team has a proven track record of growing industry-leading companies, including the Company's subsidiaries, and we actively and continuously work with and support management teams of the companies we own in managing, operating, and growing their businesses in order to provide value for our shareholders.

Our primary assets as of December 31, 2025 include our ownership interests in Alight, Inc. ("Alight"); Black Knight Football Club US, LP ("Black Knight Football" or "BKFC"); JANA Partners Capital, LLC, JANA Partners Management, LP and JANA Partners Management GP, LLC (together, "JANA" or "JANA Partners"); BGPT Catalyst, L.P. ("CSI LP", "Computer Services, Inc.", or "CSI"); Watkins Holdings, LLC ("Watkins"); JANA Strategic Investments Benchmark Fund, L.P. - Series A-1 ("JANA Fund"); High Sierra Distillery, LP ("Minden Mill"); AmeriLife Group, LLC ("AmeriLife"); O'Charley's Holdings, LLC ("O'Charley's"); 99 Restaurants Holdings, LLC ("99 Restaurants"); and various other controlled subsidiary companies and minority equity ownership interests.

The Company conducts its business through its wholly owned subsidiary Cannae Holdings, LLC ("Cannae LLC"), a Nevada limited liability company. The Company's board of directors ("Board") oversees the management of the Company, Cannae LLC and its businesses, and the performance of our external manager, Trasimene Capital Management, LLC ("Trasimene" or our "Manager"). On May 12, 2025, Cannae, Cannae LLC and the Manager (Cannae, Cannae LLC and the Manager collectively, the "Parties"), entered into that certain Management Services Agreement Termination Agreement (the "MSA Termination Agreement").

The MSA Termination Agreement terminated the Third Amended and Restated Management Services Agreement among the Parties (the "MSA") in its entirety as of May 12, 2025 without any further obligations or liabilities other than certain obligations relating to the continued indemnification and limitation on liability and the remaining obligations of the Company and/or Cannae LLC, as applicable, to pay the Manager: (i) an amount of $0.6 million in each month from May to December 2025, representing each of the unpaid monthly Management Fees (as defined in the MSA) that would have been due to the Manager through December 31, 2025; (ii) on January 1, 2026, $11.4 million, representing the aggregate remaining unpaid monthly Management Fees that would have been due to the Manager from January 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027; (iii) on July 1, 2025, $6.7 million, representing the second installment of the unpaid Termination Fees (as defined in the MSA) that would have been due to the Manager on such date; and (iv) on July 1, 2026, $6.6 million, representing the final installment of the unpaid Termination Fees (as defined in the MSA) that would have been due to the Manager on July 1, 2026.
As of December 31, 2025, we had the following reportable segments:

Alight. This segment consists of our 7.7% ownership interest in Alight. Our Vice Chairman of the Board, Mr. Foley, serves on the board of directors of Alight. Alight is a technology-enabled services company delivering human capital management solutions to many of the world's largest and most complex organizations. This includes the implementation and administration of employee benefits (e.g., health, wealth and leaves) solutions. Alight's numerous solutions and services are utilized year-round by employees and their family members in support of their overall health, wealth and wellbeing goals. Participants can

access their solutions digitally, including through a mobile application on Alight Worklife®, their intuitive, cloud-based employee engagement platform. Through Alight Worklife, Alight believes it is defining the future of employee benefits by providing an enterprise level, integrated offering designed to drive better outcomes for organizations and individuals.
We account for our ownership of Alight using the equity method of accounting and therefore its results of operations do not consolidate into ours.

Black Knight Football. This segment consists of our 44.7% ownership interest in BKFC. BKFC is a partnership led by William P. Foley, II ("Mr. Foley" or "Bill Foley"), our Vice Chairman of the Board, that owns and operates AFC Bournemouth ("AFCB"), an English Premier League ("EPL" or the "Premier League") football club, Moreirense Futebol Clube ("MFC"), a Portuguese Primeira Liga football club, and in 2025 held a minority interest in FC Lorient ("FCL"), a French football club. Black Knight Football is a leading, multi-club operator of football assets across the world. It aims to drive on-field and financial success of each of its clubs by leveraging its multi-club model to increase pathways to player development, acquiring and developing best-in-class players and managers at each club; building best-in-class infrastructure and facilities to drive player development and supporter engagement; and increase commercial opportunities for its clubs by focusing on on-field success and leveraging the extensive networks of owners and executive management.

Black Knight Football aims to continue to expand its network of clubs through strategic acquisitions and partnerships to further enhance the benefits of its multi-club model. In June 2025, BKFC acquired a 70% ownership interest in MFC. In January 2026, BKFC acquired the remaining ownership interests in FCL and now holds a 100% ownership interest in the club.
We account for our ownership of BKFC using the equity method of accounting and therefore its results of operations do not consolidate into ours.

headings: Risks Relating to our Management Structure and Our Manager
The Management Service Agreement was negotiated between related parties and the terms, including fees payable, may not be as favorable to us as if it were negotiated with an unaffiliated third party.
Conflicts of interest could arise in connection with certain of our directors' and executive officers' discharge of fiduciary duties to our shareholders.
Members of our management team may engage in activities that compete with us or our businesses.
Risks Relating to the Restaurant Group
The success of the Restaurant Group depends, in part, on its intellectual property, which we may be unable to protect.
Risks Relating to Alight
Alight faces significant competition and its failure to compete successfully could have a material adverse effect on the financial condition and results of operations of its business.
Compliance with applicable laws and regulations including changes in such laws and regulations, their application and their interpretation, could have an adverse effect on Alight's business.
Issues relating to the use of new and evolving technologies, such as Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, in Alight's offerings may result in reputational harm and liability.
Risks Relating to Black Knight Football
BKFC is dependent on the performance and popularity of its football clubs.
BKFC's business is dependent upon its ability to attract and retain key personnel, including players.
Negotiation, pricing and terms of key media contracts are outside of Black Knight Football's control and those contracts may change in the future or expose it to certain risks.

The markets in which Black Knight Football operates are highly competitive and increased competition could adversely affect Black Knight Football's results of operations, financial condition and cash flow.
Risks Relating to JANA
Poor investment performance could lead to the loss of clients and may cause AUM, revenue and earnings to decline.
Regulatory reforms in the US could expose JANA to increasing regulatory scrutiny, as well as regulatory uncertainty.
Risks Relating to the Company's Structure
We may become subject to the Investment Company Act of 1940.
Certain executive officers and members of our Board of Directors have or will have interests and positions that could present potential conflicts.
General Risk Factors

The loss of key personnel or directors could impair our operating abilities and could have a material adverse effect on our business, investments in operating companies, financial condition and results of operations.
paragraphs: In the course of conducting our business operations, we are exposed to a variety of risks, some of which are inherent in our industry and others of which are more specific to our own businesses. In addition to the other information set forth in this Annual Report and other filings we have made and make in the future with the SEC, you should carefully consider the following risk factors and uncertainties, which could materially affect our business, financial condition or results of operations in future periods. However, other factors not discussed below or elsewhere in this Annual Report could also adversely affect our businesses, results of operations and financial condition. Therefore, the risk factors below should not be considered a complete list of potential risks that we may face.

Because the Manager is owned by our Vice Chairman, Mr. Foley, and in the past was also owned by certain of our directors and executive officers, the MSA and MSA Termination Agreement were developed by related parties, although our independent directors reviewed and approved both agreements. The terms of the MSA and MSA Termination Agreement, including fees payable, may not reflect the terms we may have received if it was negotiated with an unrelated third party. In addition, particularly as a result of our relationship with the present and past principal owners of the Manager, who are or were certain directors and members of our management team, our independent directors may determine that it is in the best interests of our shareholders not to enforce, or to enforce less vigorously, our rights under the MSA and MSA Termination Agreement because of our desire to maintain our ongoing relationship with our directors and executive officers.

Our executive officers and directors may allocate some of their time to other businesses, thereby causing conflicts of interest in their determination as to how much time to devote to our affairs, which may materially adversely affect our results of operations.

While the members of our management team devote a substantial amount of their time to the affairs of the Company, our executive officers, directors, Manager and other members of our management team may engage in other business activities. This may result in a conflict of interest in allocating their time between our operations and our management and the operations of other businesses. Their other business endeavors may involve related or unrelated parties. Conflicts of interest that arise over the allocation of time may not always be resolved in our favor and may materially adversely affect our results of operations.

Certain of our directors and executive officers are or were members of the Manager and are or were directors and executive officers of other companies. Such persons, by virtue of their positions with us, have fiduciary duties to us and our shareholders. The duties of such persons as directors or executive officers to us and our shareholders may conflict with the interests of such persons in their capacities as members or employees of the Manager.

While the members of our management team intend to devote a substantial majority of their time to the affairs of the Company, our management team is not expressly prohibited from investing in or managing other entities, including those that are in the same or similar line of business as our businesses, or required to present any particular acquisition or business opportunity to the Company.

paragraphs: On March 24, 2025, Dun & Bradstreet ("D&B") entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by Clearlake Capital Group, L.P. (the "D&B Sale"). Under the terms of the agreement, D&B shareholders received $9.15 in cash for each share of common stock they own upon closing of the D&B Sale.

In conjunction with the D&B Sale, Cannae entered into a Voting and Support Agreement with Dun & Bradstreet pursuant to which Cannae agreed to vote the 69,048,691 shares of D&B common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, for which the Company was then the beneficial owner (the "Owned Shares") in favor of the D&B Sale. Pursuant to the Voting and Support Agreement, the Company also agreed not to take certain actions, including (i) tendering any Owned Shares into any tender or exchange offer, (ii) transferring any Owned Shares (subject to certain exceptions), (iii) granting any proxies or powers of attorney or (iv) taking any action that would make any representation or warranty by the Company contained in the Voting and Support Agreement untrue or incorrect in any material respect or have the effect of preventing or disabling the Company from performing its obligations under the Voting and Support Agreement in any material respect. Under the Voting and Support Agreement, the Company was permitted to sell up to 10.0 million of the Owned Shares prior to completion of the D&B Sale or termination of the merger agreement entered into by D&B related to the D&B Sale in accordance with its terms.

As a result of the D&B Sale, we present our investment in Dun & Bradstreet as a discontinued operation in our Consolidated Financial Statements as of and for the year ended December 31, 2025 and all prior periods have been recast to reflect our investment in D&B as a discontinued operation and held for sale. See Note Q - Discontinued Operations for further discussion of our accounting for our ownership interest in D&B.

During the second quarter, we sold 10.0 million shares of common stock of D&B, and Cannae received proceeds of $89.5 million. On August 26, 2025, the D&B Sale closed, and Cannae completed the disposition of its remaining ownership interests in Dun & Bradstreet, Inc. for aggregate proceeds of $540.3 million in cash in exchange for our remaining 59,048,691 shares of common stock (the "D&B Disposition"). Following the consummation of the D&B Disposition and as of December 31, 2025, Cannae no longer has any ownership interest in D&B.

On May 12, 2025, Cannae entered into an agreement to acquire an additional 30% ownership interest in JANA Partners (the "JANA Investment") in exchange for an upfront payment of $67.5 million and potential further payments aggregating to $26.0 million if JANA Partners achieves certain assets under management thresholds (the "JANA Contingent Consideration"). The transaction closed on September 2, 2025 and as of December 31, 2025, the Company has a 50.0% total ownership interest in JANA Partners.

On September 2, 2025, Cannae invested an additional $30.0 million into the JANA Fund. We previously accounted for our investment in the JANA Fund as an equity security without a readily determinable fair value. Due to our incremental investment in the JANA Fund and JANA Partners, as of September 30, 2025, we began accounting for our ownership interest in the JANA Fund as an unconsolidated affiliate using the equity method of accounting and record our ratable share of the JANA Fund's net income or loss on a three-month lag.

During the year ended December 31, 2025, we invested $50.0 million in BKFC and as of December 31, 2025, we held a 44.7% ownership interest. In January 2026, BKFC purchased the remaining 60% equity interest in FC Lorient ("FCL") for total consideration of $70.3 million including cash of $40.7 million and stock of BKFC of $29.6 million and as a result of this transaction we now hold a 42.7% ownership interest in BKFC.

In November 2025, we sold approximately 2.5 million shares of common stock of Paysafe for $16.5 million which will generate expected tax savings for the Company as the sale resulted in an $87.3 million tax loss which the Company will use to offset capital gains realized in 2025 and to carry back the excess losses to utilize against excess capital gains realized in prior years. As of December 31, 2025, Cannae no longer has any ownership interest in the common stock of Paysafe.
In January 2025, WineDirect, Inc. completed the spin-off of its fulfillment division as WineDirect Fulfillment, LLC

paragraphs: 以下說明 Canna Holdings, Inc. 及其子公司之業務。除非另有說明，所有提及「我們」、「我們」、「我們」、「Canna」、「Canna Holdings」或「公司」之參考，均指 Canna Holdings, Inc. 及其子公司，合併計算。

我們主要取得經營中公司之權益，並積極管理及經營一組核心公司，我們致力於長期支持這些公司。有時，我們也會尋求取得具控制力或能顯著影響優質公司之重大股權，並運用我們的運營專業知識，為各子公司提供支援。我們是長期所有者，主要透過取得其他公司之控制權與治理權，參與其業務，且我們沒有預設的時間限制，規範我們出售或處分業務之時點。我們相信，我們的長期所有權與積極參與管理及運營公司，有助於為股東最大化這些業務之價值。
我們相信 Canna 為投資者提供一個強 compelling 的機會，參與由世界級管理團隊所進行之公司取得、運營與成長。從根本而言，公司尋求取得具控制力或能顯著影響優質公司之重大股權，這些公司在其產業中處於優勢地位，由最佳管理團隊經營，且所處產業具有吸引人的內生與收購成長機會。我們運用管理團隊的運營專業知識、長期關係與產業聯繫，以及資金來源能力，以識別、結構化並執行取得具這些特徵公司之股權。
我們的管理團隊在成長產業領導公司方面有經過驗證的紀錄，包括本公司之子公司，我們積極且持續與我們所擁有公司之管理團隊合作與支援，以管理、運營與成長其業務，以提供股東價值。

截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們的主要資產包括我們在 Alight, Inc.（「Alight」）；Black Knight Football Club US, LP（「Black Knight Football」或「BKFC」）；JANA Partners Capital, LLC、JANA Partners Management, LP 與 JANA Partners Management GP, LLC（合稱「JANA」或「JANA Partners」）；BGPT Catalyst, L.P.（「CSI LP」、「Computer Services, Inc.」或「CSI」）；Watkins Holdings, LLC（「Watkins」）；JANA Strategic Investments Benchmark Fund, L.P. - Series A-1（「JANA Fund」）；High Sierra Distillery, LP（「Minden Mill」）；AmeriLife Group, LLC（「AmeriLife」）；O'Charley's Holdings, LLC（「O'Charley's」）；99 Restaurants Holdings, LLC（「99 Restaurants」）；以及各種其他受控子公司公司與少數股權權益。

本公司透過其 wholly owned 子公司 Cannae Holdings, LLC（「Cannae LLC」），一間內華達州有限責任公司，進行業務。本公司董事會（「董事會」）監督本公司、Cannae LLC 及其業務之管理，以及我們外部管理人 Trasimene Capital Management, LLC（「Trasimene」或「管理人」）之表現。2025 年 5 月 12 日，Canna、Cannae LLC 與管理人（Canna、Cannae LLC 與管理人合稱「各方」）簽訂了 Management Services Agreement Termination Agreement（「MSA 終止協議」）。

MSA 終止協議於 2025 年 5 月 12 日終止各方之間之 Third Amended and Restated Management Services Agreement（「MSA」）全部內容，且除與持續賠償及限制責任相關義務，以及本公司及/或 Cannae LLC，如適用，應支付管理人之義務外，不負有任何其他義務或責任：(i) 自 2025 年 5 月至 12 月，每月支付 0.6 百萬美元，代表管理人應於 2025 年 12 月 31 日前收取之未付每月管理費用；(ii) 2026 年 1 月 1 日支付 11.4 百萬美元，代表管理人應於 2026 年 1 月 1 日至 2027 年 6 月 30 日間收取之未付每月管理費用總額；(iii) 2025 年 7 月 1 日支付 6.7 百萬美元，代表管理人應於該日收取之未付終止費用第二筆付款；(iv) 2026 年 7 月 1 日支付 6.6 百萬美元，代表管理人應於該日收取之未付終止費用最後一筆付款。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們有以下應報告分部：

Alight. 此應報告分部包含本公司持有 7.7% 的 Alight 股權。本公司董事長特別助理 Mr. Foley 為 Alight 董事會成員。Alight 是一家以科技為基礎的服務公司，為全球許多最大且最複雜的組織提供人力資本管理解決方案。此解決方案包括員工福利（例如健康、財富與休假）的實施與管理。Alight 的多種解決方案與服務全年無間斷地被員工及其家屬使用，以支持他們整體的健康、財富與生活品質目標。參與者可以
透過數位方式存取這些解決方案，包括使用 Alight Worklife® 移動應用程式，這是其直覺且基於雲端的員工參與平台。透過 Alight Worklife，Alight 認為正在定義員工福利的未來，透過提供企業級、整合性的解決方案，以推動組織與個人更好的成果。
本公司以權益法會計方式計入對 Alight 的股權，因此其營運成果不會併入本公司。

Black Knight Football. 此應報告分部包含本公司持有 44.7% 的 BKFC 股權。BKFC 是由 William P. Foley, II（"Mr. Foley" 或 "Bill Foley"），本公司董事長特別助理所領導的合夥企業，擁有並經營 AFC Bournemouth（"AFCB"），一家英格蘭超級聯賽（"EPL" 或 "英超"）足球俱樂部，Moreirense Futebol Clube（"MFC"），一家葡萄牙首組聯賽足球俱樂部，以及於 2025 年持有法國足球俱樂部 FC Lorient（"FCL"）的少數股權。Black Knight Football 是全球領先的多俱樂部足球資產經營者。其目標是透過多俱樂部模式，增加球員發展的途徑，於各俱樂部取得並培養頂級球員與教練；建立頂級基礎設施與場地，以推動球員發展與球迷參與；並透過推動場上成功與運用所有者與高階管理層的廣泛網路，增加各俱樂部的商業機會。
Black Knight Football 希望持續透過戰略收購與合作夥伴關係擴展其俱樂部網路，以進一步提升其多俱樂部模式的效益。於 2025 年 6 月，BKFC 收購了 MFC 70% 的股權。於 2026 年 1 月，BKFC 收購了 FCL 剩餘的股權，並現持有該俱樂部 100% 的股權。
本公司以權益法會計方式計入對 BKFC 的股權，因此其營運成果不會併入本公司。

paragraphs: 於 2025 年 3 月 24 日，Dun & Bradstreet（"D&B"）與 Clearlake Capital Group, L.P.（"D&B Sale"）簽訂最終協議，將被收購。根據協議條款，D&B 股東在 D&B Sale 交割時，每持有 1 股普通股可獲 9.15 美元現金。

配合 D&B Sale，Cannae 與 Dun & Bradstreet 簽訂投票與支持協議，根據協議，Cannae 同意投票支持其持有的 69,048,691 股 D&B 普通股（每股面值 0.0001 美元），以支持 D&B Sale。根據投票與支持協議，Cannae 同意不採取某些行動，包括（i）將任何 Owned Shares 進行現金認購或交換要約，（ii）轉讓任何 Owned Shares（符合特定例外情況者除外），（iii）授予任何委任書或授權書，或（iv）採取任何會使 Company 在投票與支持協議中所作出之陳述或保證不真實或不正確，或會影響 Company 履行其在投票與支持協議下義務之行動。根據投票與支持協議，Company 可在 D&B Sale 完成前或 D&B 與 D&B Sale 相關之合併協議終止前，根據協議條款，出售最多 10.0 百萬股 Owned Shares。
因 D&B Sale 之故，我們將對 Dun & Bradstreet 之投資列為已終止營運，在我們之合併財務報表中，自 2025 年 12 月 31 日財務年度及所有先前期間均已重新編製，以反映我們對 D&B 之投資為已終止營運且為出售中。請參閱附註 Q - 已終止營運，以進一步說明我們對 D&B 之投資之會計處理。

於第二季，我們出售 10.0 百萬股 D&B 普通股，Cannae 獲得 89.5 百萬美元現金。於 2025 年 8 月 26 日，D&B Sale 交割完成，Cannae 完成其對 Dun & Bradstreet, Inc. 剩餘股權之處分，獲取總計 540.3 百萬美元現金，換取我們所持之剩餘 59,048,691 股 D&B 普通股（"D&B Disposition"）。D&B Disposition 交割後，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，Cannae 已無任何 D&B 之股權。

於 2025 年 5 月 12 日，Cannae 與 JANA Partners 簽訂協議，以換取額外 30% 之股權（"JANA Investment"），支付現金 67.5 百萬美元，並可能根據 JANA Partners 達成特定管理資產門檻，再支付總計 26.0 百萬美元（"JANA Contingent Consideration"）。交易於 2025 年 9 月 2 日完成，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，Company 已持有 JANA Partners 50.0% 之總股權。

於 2025 年 9 月 2 日，Cannae 又向 JANA Fund 投資額外 30.0 百萬美元。我們先前將對 JANA Fund 之投資視為無 readily determinable fair value 之權益證券。因我們對 JANA Fund 及 JANA Partners 之額外投資，自 2025 年 9 月 30 日起，我們開始將對 JANA Fund 之股權視為未合併之關聯公司，使用權益法會計，並記錄我們對 JANA Fund 之淨收入或虧損之比例，並延後三個月進行確認。

於 2025 年 12 月 31 日財務年度，我們投資 50.0 百萬美元於 BKFC，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們持有 44.7% 之股權。於 2026 年 1 月，BKFC 購買 FC Lorient（"FCL"）剩餘 60% 之股權，總對價為 70.3 百萬美元，包括現金 40.7 百萬美元及 BKFC 股票 29.6 百萬美元，因該交易，我們現持有 BKFC 42.7% 之股權。
於 2025 年 11 月，我們出售約 2.5 百萬股 Paysafe 普通股，獲取 16.5 百萬美元，此交易預期將為 Company 帶來稅務節省，因該出售產生 87.3 百萬美元稅損，Company 將用以抵銷 2025 年所實現之資本利得，並將該稅損回溯至先前年度之資本利得以進行抵銷。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，Cannae 已無任何 Paysafe 普通股之股權。

headings: 與本公司管理架構及管理人相關之風險
管理服務契約係由關聯方之間協商訂定，其條款，包括應支付之費用，可能不如與非關聯第三方協商之條件對本公司有利。
董事及高階主管在履行對股東之信義義務時，可能產生利益衝突。
本公司管理團隊成員可能從事與本公司或其業務競爭之活動。
與餐廳集團相關之風險
餐廳集團之成功在部分程度上取決於其智慧財產權，而我們可能無法有效保護該智慧財產權。
與Alight相關之風險
Alight面臨激烈競爭，若其無法成功競爭，可能對其業務之財務狀況及營運成果造成重大不利影響。
遵守適用之法律及法規，包括法律及法規之變更、其適用與解釋，可能對 Alight 之業務產生不利影響。
與新興及演進中之科技，如人工智慧及機器學習，於 Alight 產品之應用相關之問題，可能導致聲譽損害及法律責任。
與 Black Knight Football 相關之風險
BKFC 之營運依賴其足球俱樂部之表現與人氣。
BKFC 之業務依賴其吸引並留住關鍵人員，包括球員，之能力。
關鍵媒體合約之談判、價格及條款，為 Black Knight Football 之控制範疇之外，且這些合約可能於未來有所變更，或使其面臨某些風險。
Black Knight Football 所營運之市場競爭激烈，競爭增加可能對 Black Knight Football 之營運結果、財務狀況及現金流產生不利影響。
與 JANA 相關之風險
投資績效不佳可能導致客戶流失，並可能使資產規模、營業收入及獲利下降。
美國的監管改革可能使JANA面臨日益增加的監管審查，以及監管不確定性。
與本公司結構相關的風險
我們可能成為1940年投資公司法的適用對象。
部分高階主管及董事會成員擁有或將擁有可能產生潛在衝突的利益與身分。
一般風險因素
關鍵人員或董事的流失可能影響我們的營運能力，並可能對我們的業務、對營運公司的投資、財務狀況及營運成果產生重大不利影響。
paragraphs: 在進行業務運作的過程中，我們面臨多種風險，其中一些是產業內在的，而另一些則更特定於我們自己的業務。除了本年度報告及其他我們已提交或未來將提交給證券交易委員會（SEC）的文件中所列的資訊外，您應仔細考慮下列風險因素與不確定性，這些因素可能對我們未來的業務、財務狀況或營運成果產生重大影響。然而，其他未在以下或本年度報告其他地方討論的風險因素，也可能對我們的業務、營運成果及財務狀況產生不利影響。因此，以下的風險因素不應被視為我們可能面臨的全部潛在風險清單。

由於經理人（Manager）為我們副董事長佛利（Mr. Foley）所擁有，且過去也曾為我們部分董事及高階主管所擁有，因此MSA與MSA終止協議是由關聯方所制定，儘管我們的獨立董事已審閱並批准了這兩份協議。MSA與MSA終止協議的條款，包括應支付的費用，可能不會反映我們若與無關第三方進行協商時所可能獲得的條款。此外，特別是因為我們與現任及過往經理人的主要股東之間的關係，而這些股東為我們的部分董事及管理團隊成員，我們的獨立董事可能認為，為了維持與我們董事及高階主管的持續關係，對我們在MSA與MSA終止協議下的權利，不應該強行執行，或執行力度較輕。
我們的高階主管與董事可能將部分時間投入其他業務，這可能會導致他們在決定投入多少時間於我們業務的判斷上產生利益衝突，這可能對我們的營運成果產生重大不利影響。
雖然我們管理團隊的成員投入大量時間於公司的業務，但我們的高階主管、董事、經理人及其他管理團隊成員可能參與其他業務活動。這可能會導致在時間分配上產生利益衝突，使他們在公司的業務與其他業務的運作之間取得平衡。他們的其他業務活動可能涉及相關或不相關的對象。時間分配所產生的利益衝突，並不一定會以我們為利，可能對我們的營運成果產生重大不利影響。
我們的部分董事與高階主管為經理人的成員，且為其他公司的董事與高階主管。這些人士因其在公司的職位，對我們與我們股東負有信義義務。這些人士作為董事或高階主管對我們與我們股東的義務，可能與其作為經理人成員或員工的權益產生衝突。
雖然我們管理團隊的成員意圖投入大量時間於公司的業務，但我們的管理團隊並未明確禁止投資或管理其他實體，包括那些與我們業務相同或相似的實體，也未被要求將任何特定的收購或業務機會呈報給公司。
